$comment: The model routing table the spawn gate warns from (warn-only). `order` ranks the model families low to high. Each agent, by bare name, has the table's `model` (named when a spawn sets none) and its `ceiling` (a spawn asking for a family above it draws one warning line). An agent type that is not listed is never warned about. Source: the routing table Jo approved on 2026-11-10; a row that names two models has the lower as `model` and the higher as `ceiling`, and a row's escalation target is not part of its ceiling.
